C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM or common denominator.
Tag when a step rewrites one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number items when only the fractional parts need denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after common denominators are already established.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator matching for unlike fraction parts.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a nonstandard mixed number or a whole number into a compatible whole-and-fraction form needed for subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with a mixed number or fraction.
Tag when this rewriting is done to make whole and fractional parts directly subtractable.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions of proper/improper fractions.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that is a separate operation.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separately subtracts whole parts and fraction parts without borrowing yet.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding the common denominator or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional difference appears.
Do not tag simplification of the result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part because the fractional subtraction would be negative.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into d/d and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when subtraction is then completed using the regrouped fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination alone.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction/whole-valued result to standard form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by common factors.
Tag when 0/d is rewritten as 0.
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is rewritten as a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step that produced the unsimplified result.
Do not tag recombining whole and fraction parts if no reduction or standardization occurs.
Do not tag denominator matching.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts and express the answer in an acceptable final form such as a mixed number, fraction, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into one mixed number or fraction.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as just a fraction.
Tag when the final answer statement reflects the assembled result after prior operations.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps that have not yet assembled the final result.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts into final form.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that create an extra denominator-sized unit without changing unlike denominators.
Do not tag normalization of an improper fractional part unless it also includes denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to make whole-part and fraction-part subtraction possible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only to match denominators.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the subtraction step may temporarily produce a negative fractional part before borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or rewriting operands.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as denominator-over-denominator and add it to the fractional part when direct subtraction gives a negative fraction part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 is rewritten as n/n and combined with the existing fractional part before subtracting.
Tag for whole-minus-fraction or mixed-minus-mixed problems requiring regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction cases where the fractional part is nonnegative without borrowing.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as 0 over a denominator unless a later regrouping step occurs.
Do not tag simplification of the final fraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction part to an integer/whole-number result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-terms nonzero fraction with no further reduction shown.
Do not tag recombining whole and fraction parts unless an explicit simplification is performed.
Do not tag normalization of an operand before subtraction.

skills.name: Combine final form
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into one mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when the solution explicitly states the combined final answer after partwise subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure subtraction steps before the final assembly.
Do not tag simplification-only steps unless they also explicitly combine parts into final form.
Do not tag operand rewrites done before subtraction.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items with unlike fractional denominators
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Do not tag when the only rewrite is expressing a whole number as a mixed form with 0 over a denominator
Do not tag normalization of an improper fractional part unless it also includes denominator matching

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form without changing its value.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2
Tag when the rewrite is used to align whole and fractional parts for later subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion for unlike denominators; that is S01
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun; that is S04
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fraction parts

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted
Tag when a solution separately subtracts whole parts and fraction parts after setup
Tag for same-denominator fraction subtraction that needs no prior conversion
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step of finding or creating a common denominator; that is S01
Do not tag rewriting a whole number or improper mixed number before subtraction; that is S02
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part; that is S04
Do not tag simplification or final formatting alone

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution notes a negative fractional result and borrows 1 from the whole part
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator/denominator and added to the fractional part
Tag for mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction requiring regrouping
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed
Do not tag normalization of a whole number as x + 0/d before subtraction; that is S02
Do not tag simplification after regrouping unless the fraction is actually reduced

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or zero-valued fractional part to lowest terms or an integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to a whole number
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-term nonzero fraction with no explicit simplification
Do not tag mere recombination of whole and fraction parts unless a reduction or removal of a zero fractional part occurs
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion used before subtraction; that is S01

skills.name: Combine final form
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into one mixed number
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction
Tag when the final answer is explicitly formed from previously computed parts
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself; that is S03
Do not tag simplification of a fraction or zero fractional part unless the step also explicitly assembles the final number
Do not tag setup rewrites before subtraction
